changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.comment:
Removes the employee.is_manager boolean.
Whether someone manages is decided by their organization role, mirrored from the Keycloak group their token carries: OrgRole.getManagerRoles() is what the @PreAuthorize checks read, and what the client library's isManager() computes. The column was a second, stored answer to the same question, and nothing ever wrote it. On staging it was false on all thirty rows while five people held a manager role, so the one query that read it returned an empty manager list for every organization. That query now reads the roles, and the two queries left against the column had no callers at all.
Nothing is backfilled and nothing is lost: the column carried no information that employee_org_roles does not already hold, and every row in it was false.
